## Events (TM(5,x), APIDs 0x021 and 0x022)

| ID | Name | Template |
|---|---|---|
| 0x0210 | MON_VBUS | V_BUS monitor {ev_mon_state} {ev_side}: {ev_value} mV (limit {ev_limit}) |
| 0x0220 | MON_TBAT | T_BAT monitor {ev_mon_state} {ev_side}: {ev_value} cdegC (limit {ev_limit}) |
| 0x0230 | MON_TOBC | T_OBC monitor {ev_mon_state} {ev_side}: {ev_value} cdegC (limit {ev_limit}) |
| 0x0301 | HEARTBEAT_MISSED | Heartbeat missed: {ev_task} (miss {ev_count}) |
| 0x0302 | TASK_RESTARTED | Task restarted: {ev_task} ({ev_count} in window) |
| 0x0303 | TASK_ESCALATED | Task escalated: {ev_task} after {ev_count} restarts |
| 0x0304 | ACTION_INHIBITED | FDIR action inhibited (kind {ev_kind}, subject {ev_subject}) |
| 0x0305 | TASK_RECOVERED | Task recovered: {ev_task} |
| 0x0401 | MODE_CHANGED | MODE {ev_mode_from} -> {ev_mode_to} (cause {ev_cause} {ev_cause_detail}) |
| 0x0402 | INHIBIT_CHANGED | FDIR inhibit on={ev_on} for {ev_duration} s (reason {ev_reason}) |
| 0x0403 | SCHED_SUSPENDED | Schedule suspended ({ev_entries} activities kept) |
| 0x0404 | MODE_CMD_DISCARDED | Mode command discarded (event {ev_sm_event}, source {ev_src}) |
| 0x0405 | MODE_INVALID | Mode state invalid ({ev_raw_state}), recovered to SAFE |
| 0x0410 | THERMAL_RECOVERY_ATTEMPT | THERMAL recovery attempt {ev_attempt}/{ev_attempt_max}: {ev_param} = {ev_value} cdegC |
| 0x0411 | THERMAL_RECOVERED | THERMAL recovered after {ev_attempts} attempt(s), staying DEGRADED |
| 0x0412 | THERMAL_RECOVERY_EXHAUSTED | THERMAL recovery EXHAUSTED after {ev_attempts} attempts ({ev_param}): SAFE requested |
| 0x0420 | PAYLOAD_COMMANDED | PAYLOAD enable={ev_payload_cmd} running={ev_payload_running} |
| 0x0501 | BOOT_REPORT | BOOT #{ev_boot_count}: last reset {ev_last_reset}, mode {ev_boot_mode}, NV valid {ev_nv_valid} |
| 0x0502 | WDG_WARNING | Watchdog early warning ({ev_since_kick_ms} ms since kick) |
| 0x0601 | SEC_REJECT_FIRST | SECURITY: TC rejected, class {ev_rej_class} ({ev_rej_code}), total {ev_rej_total} |
| 0x0602 | SEC_REJECT_SUMMARY | SECURITY: {ev_rej_count} more {ev_rej_class} rejections in {ev_rej_window} s, total {ev_rej_total} |
| 0x0603 | SEC_KEY_LOADED | SECURITY: key loaded in slot {ev_slot}, KCV {ev_kcv; %08X} |
| 0x0604 | SEC_KEY_ACTIVATED | SECURITY: slot {ev_slot} ACTIVE (was {ev_prev_slot}), KCV {ev_kcv; %08X}, by recovery {ev_by_recovery} |
| 0x0605 | SEC_KEY_CORRUPT | SECURITY: key LOST in slot mask {ev_slot_mask} (scrub errors {ev_scrub_errors}) |
| 0x0606 | SEC_COUNTER_VOTE | SECURITY: counter copies disagreed (mask {ev_slot_mask}), largest taken |
| 0x0607 | SEC_RECOVERY_USED | SECURITY: RECOVERY command {ev_rec_subtype} slot {ev_slot}, challenge {ev_challenge} |
| 0x0608 | SEC_KEY_ERASED | SECURITY: slot {ev_slot} erased |
| 0x0609 | SEC_COUNTER_SET | SECURITY: slot {ev_slot} counter {ev_old} -> {ev_new} |
| 0x060A | SEC_KEY_LOAD_FAILED | SECURITY: wrapped key for slot {ev_slot} did not verify |
| 0x060B | SEC_FACTORY_STATE | SECURITY: key store blank or invalid, factory state |
| 0x060C | SEC_KEY_REPAIRED | SECURITY: key store upset repaired by the scrub ({ev_repairs}) |
